cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Chrome 给 agent 发了一份官方指引
五天从日增 8 星冲到 3,474
cover.dek: Chrome 团队 11-10 发布 Modern Web Guidance 1.0，一个 skill 加 CLI，让 agent 按需拉取最新的 Web 平台指引。5 天前每天只有 8–15 星，现在还在涨，HN 上也有 447 分。
cover.title_en:
Chrome Ships Official Guidance for Agents
From 8 Stars a Day to 3,474 in Five Days
cover.dek_en: Chrome released Modern Web Guidance 1.0 on 11-10, a skill plus a CLI that lets agents pull current web platform guidance on demand. It was gaining 8 to 15 stars a day five days ago, is still climbing, and scored 447 on Hacker News.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: MemoryDojo 测记忆投毒：155 条长程轨迹、5 种记忆系统，没有一个能躲过。
stickers.text_en: MemoryDojo tested memory poisoning on 155 long-horizon trajectories and 5 memory systems. All of them were affected.

stickers.title: 新秀
stickers.text: Tencent/LoopForge 日增 +513，涨幅 66.2%，是新秀里加速最明显的。
stickers.text_en: Tencent/LoopForge gained 513 stars in a day, up 66.2%, the fastest-accelerating newcomer.

stickers.title: 带货观察
stickers.text: morluto/rea 日增 +2,136，视频播放约 147 万，真实讨论只找到 2 条。
stickers.text_en: morluto/rea gained 2,136 stars in a day on about 1.47M video views, with only 2 real discussions found.
